gates.rule: treatment post-feedback rank is strictly better than baseline post-feedback rank
treatment ceiling rank after feedback is no worse than its initial rank
every direct expected source rank is non-regressing
every lexical expected source rank is non-regressing and lexical or zero-hop feedback changes no edge
the reverse-direction source remains absent and relation ordering remains unchanged
every feedback node has the registered endpoint/type path on the persisted relation trace
baseline changes credited edges only; treatment additionally reduces only registered uncredited same-source siblings
a missing later credited edge rolls back earlier edge and feedback writes
a second in-run construction has the same stable observation

holdout_rule: open holdout exactly once only if every development gate passes
stop_rule: save any failing development or holdout result and do not tune or rerun
